title: Version map
description: Says which commit of a repository each worker version was built from. An overlay uses it to lay every history over the workflow documents of the commit that ran it.

versions.description: One entry per worker version. No two entries name the same deployment and build id.

unversioned.description: The commit for histories whose workers reported no version. Without it such histories are left out.

commit.description: A commit, written as the directory that holds its workflow documents is named. A SHA may be abbreviated to its first four or more characters, as long as no other directory begins the same way.

deployment.description: Name of the Worker Deployment the version belongs to. An entry without it stands for its build id in every deployment and for workers that report a build id alone (WorkerOptions.setBuildId), and yields to an entry that names the deployment.

commit.description: The commit the workers were built from.
